sources.title: Rapid Growth in AI for Animal Health: Market Expected to Reach $4.21 Billion by 2030
sources.claim: Global AI in animal health market is expected to reach $4.21 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 19.6%; market grew from $1.72B in 2025 to $2.06B in 2026

sources.title: IDEXX Laboratories Acquires CoVetAI to Advance Veterinary Workflow Intelligence
sources.claim: IDEXX acquired CoVetAI on September 16, 2026 to integrate AI ambient listening and clinical workflow software into its veterinary diagnostics ecosystem

sources.title: Digitail Raises $23M USD Series B Led by Five Elms Capital
sources.claim: Digitail raised $23M Series B in November 2025, bringing total investment to $37M, supporting 10,000 veterinarians and 3 million pet parents across its AI-native practice management platform

sources.title: AI Is Reshaping Veterinary Medicine: Investment Surges as Diagnostic, Documentation, and Remote Monitoring Technologies Gain Traction
sources.claim: AI adoption in veterinary practices grew from 11% in 2025 to 27% in 2026; Lupa Pets secured ~$20M Series A funding; diagnostic imaging identified as highest-impact clinical AI application

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) In Animal Health Market Size, Report By 2035
sources.claim: AI in animal health market predicted to increase from USD 2.01 billion in 2026 to approximately USD 9.56 billion by 2035, expanding at a CAGR of 18.99%

sources.title: AI Veterinary Diagnostics Market: Regaining Its Glory | Mars Petcare, IDEXX Laboratories, Zoetis
sources.claim: Mars Petcare's Banfield captures 11.5% and VCA captures 10% of AI veterinary citation share; companion animal diagnostics market valued at USD 7.6 billion in 2026

sources.title: United States Department of Agriculture Fiscal Year 2025-2026 AI Strategy
sources.claim: USDA published formal AI strategy for FY2025-2026 targeting livestock disease surveillance and zoonotic outbreak early warning systems with AI

sources.title: One health strategies against antimicrobial resistance integrating artificial intelligence genomics and environmental surveillance for planetary health
sources.claim: AI-driven surveillance systems for antimicrobial resistance integrate genomic sequences, clinical records, environmental samples, antimicrobial usage, and epidemiological data from human, veterinary, and environmental sources

sources.title: Pet Humanization: Millennials And Gen Z Turn Pets Into Family — Fueling Pet Boom
sources.claim: 69% of Millennials and Gen Z view pets as family members; U.S. pet industry expenditures reached $158 billion in 2025; average pet owner spends $1,100+/year on health costs
